description: Built the Ryan Menke call prep sheet from web research and calendar data only, without checking the M365 email connector for the actual introduction thread. Concluded the call was a sales/prospect intro sourced from an ambiguous 'OFS' company match, and stated Ryan Menke's title as CRO & President at OFS Brands (furniture manufacturer).
correction: The email thread (Rex Miller, 'Re: Connecting you with David O'Hara', 2026-07-03/07-06) shows Rex Miller introduced David to Ryan Menke through the AI Mastermind group. Ryan Menke is Chief Strategy Officer at OFS (contract-furniture manufacturer, Huntingburg, IN) — not CRO & President. The call is a peer/thought-leadership conversation about AI and workforce/business impact, both being YPO members, not a sales prospect intro.
systemic_fix: When building call/meeting prep sheets, always query the connected email account (query_email_and_calendar) for the introduction or most recent thread with the attendee before falling back to web research for identity and context. Web research should supplement, not substitute for, available first-party email context.
